categories.label: Writing

categories.label: Tool execution
categories.evidence: Four execution entries report failures: two timeouts, one permission denial, and one server-tool error. A documentation request about browser behavior is excluded.

surprising: Tool execution is the clearest weakness: all four relevant entries report friction, including repeated timeouts, a permission denial, and a server-tool error. These are reported operational failures; their root causes are not established.

recommended.reason: Track recovery and completion after render timeouts.
Improve tone and voice after an explicit writing correction.
Identify generic language reported in writing feedback.

headline: Research verification: covered; Tool execution: critical friction.
scope: Results describe the supplied sample, not the model’s intelligence. Entries contain requests and reported friction, not independently verified outcomes.

methodology.ratingMeaning: Covered means repeated task coverage with no explicit friction in this sample; it does not establish successful performance. Weak and Critical require explicit reported friction.
methodology.strongestBasis: Research verification has repeated coverage and no reported friction; successful research execution is unverified. Volume alone is not evidence of capability.
methodology.recommendationMeaning: Relevant to observed gaps, not confirmed missing installations.
